name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.180: The correction section showed FIVE switches for ONE mechanism, and the operator
    said so plainly: "Ein toggle, nicht 5". It is now one switch, "Correct subtitle timing", doing
    what all five described: shift the file onto the audio (one constant offset, or segment by
    segment when the offset moves), or repair it line-by-line against a same-language reference
    when the item has one. Which audio track is read is no longer a setting — choosing it by
    language is simply right. The drift-report and drift-reject switches are gone: they belonged
    to the model in which a moving offset could only be reported or refused, and the staircase
    replaced that model.
    Two findings from reviewing the result: the reference repair hung off its own removed switch,
    so unticking the one visible toggle would have left the reference route running — it now
    follows the same switch. And the UI wiring check asserts ABSENCE of the four removed ids in
    both markup and JS, because a leftover document.querySelector on a removed element throws at
    load and takes every binding on the page with it.
